propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture hard-fails on git fetch origin tickets with exit status 128, but captures stderr and discards it via subprocess.run(capture_output=True, check=True), making the actual cause (auth, missing ref, network error, etc.) undiagnosable
git fetch is a single un-retried network call on the critical path of the external integration harness, so any transient network blip takes the entire test cell out as an ERROR
git archive and git ls-tree calls in dc_store_copy_repo use the identical capture_output=True + check=True pattern, exposing the same diagnostic loss and lack of retry for all three git operations
the fix routes all three git calls through a new _run_git helper that captures stderr, checks the exit status itself, and raises RuntimeError carrying the command, exit status, and verbatim stderr

the fetch call is wrapped in a new _fetch_tickets helper that retries a bounded number of times with backoff on transient failure, but still fails hard (never skip) on final failure so genuine misconfigurations are not silently dropped
